description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to target resolution within a plugin system, specifically testing 'buildUnresolvedTargetResults' and 'resolveTargetsWithOptionalToken'. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: buildUnresolvedTargetResults
methods.description: Creates an array marking each input as unresolved with a specified note.

methods.name: resolveTargetsWithOptionalToken
methods.description: Resolves target inputs potentially using an optional token, returning resolved entries or unresolved notes based on token presence.
